item.title: Musician Sara Bareilles talks about the importance of crying in her life
item.description: On Wild Card, famous guests answer questions that we don't always talk about. Musician Sara Bareilles talks about the importance of crying in her life.

item.title: A stranger helped a mother and son stuck in a current in Lake Michigan
item.description: A mother was caught in a current while saving her son in Lake Michigan. When she couldn't get them closer to shore, a man appeared to help.

item.title: New book traces the pieces of steel salvaged from the World Trade Center
item.description: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Sam Holleran, one of the authors behind the new book Scattered Steel: the afterlife of the World Trade Center.

item.title: At Minnesota's state fair, crop artists depict the struggle over immigration enforcement
item.description: Nearly 600 artists submitted crop art at the Minnesota State Fair. Using seeds from Minnesota grown crops, many artists created scenes inspired by Operation Metro Surge.
item.content:encoded: Nearly 600 artists submitted crop art at the Minnesota State Fair. Using seeds from Minnesota grown crops, many artists created scenes inspired by Operation Metro Surge.

item.title: Trump's arch may break ground without final approval. Veterans are trying to stop it
item.description: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum says "excavation work" will begin in the next two weeks, without approval from a key federal body. Veterans who sued over the arch want a judge to intervene before then.

item.title: No wonder 'Coyote vs. Acme' is resonating. It's about runaway corporate power
item.description: Blending live action with animation, Coyote vs. Acme is a spoof of the classic legal thriller. Think The Verdict or Erin Brockovich — but steeped in the surreal anarchy of Looney Tunes.

item.description: Women in politics and pop culture are paying tribute to Gloria Steinem after her death at 92. Many called her not only an inspiration but a friend.

item.title: Later in life, Gloria Steinem found herself free of the 'demands of gender'
item.description: In 2015, the trailblazing feminist told Fresh Air she that had entered a new phase in life, one in which "you can do what you want." Steinem died Sept. 2 at the age of 92.

item.title: See inequity through the eyes of a 'tee girl' at a fancy resort in 'Filipiñana'
item.description: Seventeen-year-old Isabel tees up balls for golfers in a lush luxury oasis in Manila. It's the feature film debut of writer and director Rafael Manuel, and every shot of Filipiñana churns with life.

item.title: 'The Uprising' director Paul Greengrass on the 'great rage' of history -- and today
item.description: Greengrass' latest film is set in 1381 England and centers on a farmer who leads an army against the king. His previous films include the Jason Bourne movies, United 93 and Captain Phillips.
